Today's selection covers 113 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 74 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned. What happens next?
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Your Endpoint Management Platform Could Be Your Biggest Security Risk
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, Krebs on Security, The Verge, SecurityWeek, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 61 articles published in the last 24 hours
